text: The weather on Earth is changing. Every day, the sun makes our planet warm, but now the temperature is going up too fast. Some places have less rain, and the land is very dry. Other places have too much rain, and there are big storms with strong wind. In some countries, there is less snow and ice in winter than before. Scientists say our climate is changing because of pollution. This is a big problem for people, animals, and plants. In the past, each season was easy to know: a cold winter, a warm spring, a hot summer, and a cool autumn. Now the seasons are not the same every year. Sometimes it is hot when it should be cold. I look at the sky and the clouds every morning to check the weather. I think we must help our planet. We can walk more and use fewer cars. Small changes can help stop the problem. The Earth is our home, and we must take care of it for the future.
